title: Part-Time Marketing & Operations Assistant (Remote)
description:
Schedule: Part-Time, with daily and monthly responsibilities



About the Position

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Part-Time Marketing & Operations Assistant to support our marketing and customer service operations.



The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with reports, reviewing customer calls, tracking marketing campaigns, creating tasks, and preparing promotional materials. We are open to candidates with different strengths, particularly those with experience in customer service, marketing support, data entry, or administrative tasks.



We value someone who is proactive, reliable, organized, and capable of working independently.



Key Responsibilities will include campaign tracking, call classification, management of promotional materials, reports, and other admin task as needed by the company.



Preferred Qualifications



We welcome applicants with different professional strengths. Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus:



Website management, website updates, or basic website maintenance.

Customer service or call center experience.

Marketing coordination and campaign tracking.

Data entry, reporting, and spreadsheet management.

Administrative and task management.

Basic graphic design and promotional material creation.

Experience using Canva, Google Sheets, Excel, or similar tools.

Experience with CRM, call tracking, or customer service platforms.

Experience in the HVAC, plumbing, home services, or call center industry is an advantage but not required.



Skills We're Looking For

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Good written and verbal English communication.

Ability to analyze information and identify discrepancies.

Proactive in following up on pending tasks.

Comfortable handling repetitive reporting and data classification.

Able to work independently and meet daily deadlines.

Willingness to learn new systems and processes.



How to Apply

If you are interested, please submit the following:

Your updated resume.

A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience (a video introduction is better 😊 )

A description of your strongest skills, particularly in customer service, website management, marketing, reporting, or administrative work.

Any relevant samples of promotional slides, reports, or marketing materials you have created (if available).



Please use "Marketing & Operations Assistant – [Your Name]" as the subject of your application.



We look forward to hearing from you!

description:
Airbnb Operations & AI Virtual Assistant



We are hiring a dedicated virtual assistant to support the daily operation of a growing Airbnb apartment business. If you don't read full job description you will automatically be denied.

- Reconcile figures and flag missing or unusual transactions

- Experienced in working in Airbnb, hospitality, property management, customer service, or bookkeeping

- Can accept feedback and improve rapidly



Performance expectations:



- Acknowledge routine messages within 10 minutes during working hours

- Acknowledge urgent guest issues within 5 minutes

- Complete ordinary assigned tasks by the agreed deadline

- Keep financial records current and accurate

- Provide proactive updates without being chased

- Raise problems early and suggest solutions

7. The phrase “ownership and speed” at the beginning of your application



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical assessment.

title: Creative Marketing Assistant – Video, Design & Promotional Materials
description:
# Creative Marketing Assistant – Video, Design & Promotional Materials



**Part-Time | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity**



**Salary:** AUD $100 per week (approximately USD $70)



**Hours:** Approximately 10–15 hours per week, depending on experience and agreed rate



**Flexible working hours | Australian entertainment business**



### About Us



We are **Amazing Drumming Monkeys**, a much-loved Australian children's entertainment show combining live music, comedy, puppetry and plenty of audience participation.



We've been entertaining families for many years, performing at major festivals, theatres, schools and community events across Australia and sometimes internationally.



We have a fantastic show, years of wonderful footage, photographs, reviews and audience feedback. Now we're looking for a creative person to help us bring all of this together into professional, engaging marketing materials that capture the magic of what we do.



We're a small, friendly, independent business, and we're looking for someone who would genuinely enjoy becoming part of our journey.



### What We're Looking For



We need a creative, organised and enthusiastic person with strong graphic design and video editing skills who can help us develop a professional collection of marketing assets.



We want someone who can do more than simply follow instructions. We'd love to find someone with a good creative eye, who can suggest ideas, understand our audiences and help us showcase why our show is so special.



**Our initial priorities are:**



**1. Professional Presentation & Booking Packs**



Create a beautiful, engaging PDF presentation pack that we can send to theatres, festivals, venues, major events and entertainment buyers.



This should communicate the quality, personality and success of our show through great design, photography, reviews, touring history and audience testimonials.



We may also develop shorter versions for specific markets.



**2. Promotional Videos for Different Audiences**



Using our existing footage, photographs and reviews, create promotional videos tailored to different booking markets, including:



- Schools and educational performances

- Kindergartens and early childhood centres

- Music, arts and family festivals

- International festivals and overseas presenters

- Councils and local government events

- Agricultural shows, country fairs and community events

- Theatres, performing arts centres and major entertainment venues



Each market has different needs, and we'd like someone who understands how to tailor the message, footage and presentation accordingly.



**3. Website Refresh**



Once our new promotional materials are developed, we'd like help updating and improving our existing website using the new videos, photographs, testimonials and marketing content.



Experience with website design or updating websites would be an advantage, but it is built on the bandzoogle platform whihc is relatively easy to navigate. 



**4. Ongoing Marketing Asset Management**



We regularly capture new footage, photographs, reviews and testimonials from our performances.



We'd love someone who can become familiar with our content library and keep our promotional materials fresh and up to date as new material becomes available.



### How the Role Could Grow



Once our core marketing materials are established, we'd love to explore expanding the role to include:



- Creating and scheduling social media content

- Helping us reach potential venues, festivals and event organisers

- Researching new performance and touring opportunities

- Assisting with promotional campaigns for upcoming tours and festivals

- Developing new ideas to help grow the business



These are future possibilities rather than immediate requirements. Our first priority is finding someone who is excellent at creating professional marketing assets.



### Skills & Experience



**Essential:**



- Strong graphic design skills, particularly Canva

- Excellent video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar)

- Experience creating professional PDF presentations, pitch decks or media kits

- Ability to work with existing video footage and photographs

- Good written English and communication skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Creativity, initiative and the ability to work independently

- Reliable and organised



**Bonus skills:**



- Website design or website content management

- Social media marketing

- Experience promoting entertainment, music, festivals or live events

- An understanding of Australian audiences



### The Person We'd Love to Find



We're hoping to find someone who genuinely enjoys what we do!



Our show is fun, musical, playful and full of personality. We'd love to work with someone who connects with that energy and gets excited about helping us share it with more audiences.



Someone who takes pride in their work, brings their own creative ideas and enjoys seeing a small business grow.



We're not looking for a large agency or someone managing dozens of clients. We'd prefer to build a personal, ongoing working relationship with one talented person who gets to know our business.



This is an ongoing part-time opportunity, subject to the arrangement working well for both of us.



### How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself and why this role interests you.

2. Examples of promotional videos you've created.

3. Examples of PDF presentations, media kits or pitch decks you've designed.

4. Your experience with Canva, video editing and websites.

5. Your hourly rate and how many hours you could offer within our AUD $100 weekly budget.



**Important:** Please include the word **MONKEYS** in the subject line of your application so we know you've read the advertisement.



We'd love to find someone creative, enthusiastic and reliable who wants to help us take Amazing Drumming Monkeys to the next level!

title: Python & Applied AI Engineer

The Comeragh Group is recruiting for an Australian AI company. It builds an AI-based risk management tool for heavy industry and mining. The product already works and is in a live client trial. They need skilled developers who can work independently and use their own technical judgement.

pytest, Docker, Git pull requests and at least one major cloud

Clear written and spoken English



Nice to have: watsonx, MCP, LangChain/LangGraph, RAG and vector search, pandas/SQL, and parsing Excel, PDF and Word files. You don’t need to know risk management; the client will teach you that.

title: Junior Patient Care & Medical Billing Associate – Prompt EMR Required
description:
Applications submitted without the required video introduction will not be considered.



TruWell Physical Therapy is hiring a Junior Patient Care & Medical Billing Associate to support our Brighton and Commerce Township, Michigan offices.



This remote position combines patient communication, scheduling, and administrative support with medical billing and revenue cycle management.



Hands-on experience using Prompt Healthcare EMR and previous U.S. medical billing experience are required.



You will work alongside our patient care and billing team, follow established procedures, and take responsibility for assigned tasks through completion. This is a junior associate position for someone with relevant experience who is organized, dependable, comfortable speaking with patients and insurance companies, and interested in developing their skills.



Responsibilities



Patient Communication and Scheduling



- Answer patient phone calls, return voi
s, and respond to texts and
s professionally.

- Schedule and reschedule new patient evaluations and follow-up appointments in Prompt.

- Help fill schedule openings using cancellation lists, waitlists, and patient follow-up.

- Contact patients about new referrals and prescriptions to help them schedule their first appointment.

- Send intake forms and follow up on missing paperwork, insurance cards, and other required documents.

- Assist patients through our virtual front desk or video communication system when assigned.

- Coordinate with both offices and route clinical questions to the appropriate therapist.



Insurance and Administrative Support



- Verify insurance eligibility and benefits, including deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and visit limits.

- Help track authorization requirements, approved visits, and expiration dates; flag issues needing attention.

- Follow up with physician offices for signed plans of care, prescriptions, and missing documentation.

- Upload documents to the correct patient chart and case, and maintain accurate information in Prompt.

- Explain verified benefits and patient balances using approved clinic procedures.

- Assist with patient payments, receipts, superbills, and approved payment arrangements through authorized systems.



Medical Billing and Revenue Cycle Support



- Review assigned claims for accuracy and missing information before submission.

- Submit and track claims, and correct and resubmit claims according to established procedures.

- Investigate assigned claim rejections and denials, identify the reason, and take appropriate follow-up action.

- Contact insurance companies about claim status, unpaid claims, and payment discrepancies.

- Work assigned accounts receivable (A/R) aging lists and document the next action for each account.

- Assist with reviewing EOBs/ERAs, posting insurance payments, and reconciling payment discrepancies.

- Help investigate underpayments and recurring billing problems, escalating complex issues to the billing lead.

- Provide clear updates on outstanding claims, denials, completed work, and items requiring assistance.



Required Qualifications



- Previous hands-on experience using Prompt Healthcare EMR.

- Previous medical billing or RCM experience involving U.S. health insurance claims.

- Working knowledge of claim submission, rejections, denials, EOBs/ERAs, payment posting, and A/R follow-up.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Comfortable making and receiving calls with patients, physician offices, and insurance companies.

- Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

- Ability to complete routine assigned work independently and recognize when to ask for help.

- Ability to balance patient communication with scheduled billing and administrative assignments.

- A reliable computer, stable internet connection, headset, and quiet, private workspace.

- Availability during agreed U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- Commitment to following HIPAA and TruWell’s patient privacy and security procedures.



Preferred Qualifications



- Physical therapy or outpatient rehabilitation experience.

- Experience with patient scheduling, intake, and insurance verification.

- Experience with Medicare and commercial insurance.

- Experience tracking prior authorizations and signed plans of care.

- Experience using Weave or another medical office phone and texting platform.



What We Are Looking For



We want someone who is friendly with patients, accurate with details, and consistent about following up.



You should be able to explain what you have completed, what remains unresolved, and what needs to happen next. When an assigned claim is unpaid or a patient task is incomplete, we expect you to investigate, document your work, and continue following up or escalate appropriately.



You will support our existing team, with responsibilities assigned according to clinic needs and your demonstrated skills.



How to Apply



Please include your résumé and answer the following:



1. How much experience do you have in medical billing and revenue cycle management?

2. How long have you used Prompt Healthcare EMR, when did you last use it, and which tasks did you personally perform?

3. Have you worked with a physical therapy or outpatient rehabilitation practice? Please describe your role.

4. What experience do you have with patient calls, scheduling, intake, and insurance verification?

5. Which billing responsibilities have you personally handled, including claims, denials, payment posting, and A/R follow-up?

6. What days and hours are you available to work in U.S. Eastern Time?

7. What is your desired hourly rate?

8. When would you be available to start?



Video Introduction Required



Include a link to a 1–3 minute video introduction with your application.



In your video, please:



- Briefly introduce yourself and describe your relevant patient care and medical billing experience.

- Explain specifically how you have used **Prompt Healthcare EMR**, including tasks you personally completed.

- Describe one **denial or unpaid A/R claim** you worked on: what the problem was, what steps you took, and the outcome or next step.

- Tell us about your comfort speaking with patients and insurance companies.

- Explain why this combined patient care and billing position interests you.



Use examples without patient names or identifying information, and make sure your video link is accessible.



Applications submitted without the required video introduction will not be considered.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
// About Us //

Qontour is a boutique agency based primarily in California (USA) with a diverse, globally distributed team. We create brands, build websites, and develop marketing materials of all kinds, mainly for B2B SaaS cybersecurity companies. Our workdays run on Pacific Time. International team members keep at least a four-hour daily overlap with that time zone.



// About the Role //

We are looking for  team member to own Qontour’s own content pipeline from draft to publish across the blog and LinkedIn, and acts as the company’s voice in day-to-day conversation on social platforms. The publishing side runs through an established AirOps-to-Claude-to-Webflow workflow. The engagement side is about showing up consistently and adding something useful to the conversation.



// Responsibilities //



Blog publishing:

- Produce blog posts that target AirOps visibility opportunities, run them through the existing workflow, finalize in Claude, and submit for approval

- Develop image concepts in Claude, generate them in Midjourney, and submit two options for approval with a short rationale for each

- Publish to Webflow, either by exporting directly from AirOps or pasting in manually



Social media:

- Write a LinkedIn post for each blog that links back to it

- Adapt blogs into LinkedIn articles

- Adapt all social content from the original blog using Claude, with platform-appropriate edits rather than straight copies

- Create visuals as either a variant of the blog thumbnail or a slide reel

- Publish occasional standalone visibility posts when AirOps recommends them



Community engagement:

- Spend time daily on LinkedIn and other relevant platforms, engaging both through the Qontour company page and from their own profile as a Qontour team member

- Help people working through questions in B2B marketing, Webflow, AEO, and the cybersecurity and deep tech spaces we work in – answering, pointing to resources, and joining discussions where we have something useful to add

- Keep the tone helpful rather than promotional, in line with Qontour’s voice

- Surface trends, recurring questions, and topics worth turning into future blog posts



Tracking:

- Tracking and setting up campaigns in AirOps to track content changes and social media opportunities



Primary tools used:

AirOps, Claude, Midjourney, Webflow, LinkedIn



// What We're Looking For //

The ideal candidate for this position:

- Genuinely enjoys social media and is active on LinkedIn already

- Is comfortable representing Qontour publicly under their own name

- Can hold their own in conversations with technical and marketing audiences without overreaching on expertise

- Is comfortable working inside AI-assisted workflows and knowing where the output needs a human edit

- Can refine Claude drafts to Qontour’s voice without rewriting them from scratch

- Has basic Webflow CMS experience, or can quickly learn

- Has reasonable visual judgment for selecting and pitching image options

- Is familiar with B2B (technical subject matter is a plus)

title: Property Management Virtual Assistant (Gig-Based)
description:
We are an Ohio-based real estate investment company operating in the Eastern Time Zone. Our business focuses on acquiring, renovating, and renting residential properties. We are currently looking for a dependable, organized Virtual Assistant to help oversee the online leasing and day-to-day coordination of our 16-unit rental portfolio.



Important: This is a gig-based position, not a full-time or salaried job. Because we operate a relatively small portfolio, we hire on an as-needed basis. However, for someone who performs well and is a good fit, there is potential for ongoing, recurring part-time work.



Key Responsibilities

1. Leasing and Tenant Communication

Create, update, and maintain rental listings through Zillow Rental Manager.

Check and respond to prospective tenant messages at least three times daily.

Review and screen prospective applicants according to our rental criteria.

Coordinate apartment showings with our local showing assistant.

Communicate with applicants and help guide them through the application process.

Provide the owner with a short daily summary of leasing activity and outstanding items.



2. Vendor and Staff Coordination

Create job advertisements to recruit apartment cleaners, showing assistants, and maintenance/construction contractors.

Review applicants and help identify qualified candidates.

Communicate with vendors and coordinate scheduling and work assignments.



3. Property Operations



Respond to existing tenant maintenance requests and help coordinate resolutions.

Assist with lease renewals and ongoing tenant communication.

Monitor rent collection and maintain accurate rental and payment records.

Keep property information and records organized and up to date.

Qualifications and Requirements

Previous experience in residential property management, leasing, or a similar role is required.

Strong written and spoken English skills.

Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

Comfortable with data entry and maintaining accurate records.

Experience using Zillow Rental Manager and Google Workspace is strongly preferred.

Comfortable communicating through WhatsApp.

Willing and able to use Clockify for time tracking and Sendwave for payments.

Dependable, proactive, and capable of working independently.

Able to work flexible hours and communicate with a US-based owner operating on Eastern Time.



Position Details

Pay: $5 USD per hour.

Payment Method: Sendwave.

Start Date: Monday.

Schedule: Flexible, gig-based hours depending on workload.

Communication: WhatsApp.

Time Tracking: Clockify.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining your relevant experience. Include examples of previous property management, leasing, or tenant communication work.



Your application must also include:

Your earliest available start date.

How many hours per day you are available to work.

Confirmation that you understand this is a gig-based position rather than guaranteed full-time employment.

A photo of your favorite city in the USA.

title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper – Real Estate Investment Company
description:

This is an ongoing, part-time gig position. During the initial phase, you should expect approximately 2 hours of work per day as we organize and clean up the existing books. Once everything is up to date and properly organized, the workload is expected to decrease to approximately 1 hour per day.



I am looking for someone who is trustworthy, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking responsibility for maintaining accurate financial records.



Job Responsibilities

1. QuickBooks Online Bookkeeping

     Maintain the company's financial records in QuickBooks Online.

     Properly categorize income, expenses, and other transactions.

     Reconcile bank accounts and credit card statements.

     Review transactions for accuracy and correct classification.

     Find and correct duplicate, uncategorized, or incorrectly classified transactions.

     Maintain organized bookkeeping records for a small real estate portfolio.

    Assist with monthly financial reviews and reporting.



2. QuickBooks Cleanup and Organization 

Our existing QuickBooks company file has accumulated several inactive, dormant, and potentially unnecessary accounts. One of your first priorities will be to review and improve the current bookkeeping setup.

This will include:

     Reviewing the existing Chart of Accounts.

     Identifying duplicate, inactive, dormant, or unnecessary accounts.

     Recommending which accounts should be retained, consolidated, or deactivated.

     Reviewing and correcting transaction classifications when appropriate.

     Improving the overall organization of the books.

     Establishing a clean, manageable bookkeeping system going forward.

     Important: You must be comfortable inheriting an existing QuickBooks file that needs attention, organization, and cleanup.



3. Communication and Accountability

     Send a brief daily activity report summarizing completed work, hours worked, and any outstanding issues.

     Attend a scheduled one-hour weekly meeting with the owner to discuss progress, questions, and priorities.

     Communicate promptly when clarification or approval is needed.

     Bring unusual transactions, discrepancies, and potential problems to the owner's attention rather than guessing or making     unauthorized changes.



Hours and Compensation

    Hourly Rate: $6 USD.

    Initial Workload: Approximately 2 hours per day.

   Ongoing Workload: Approximately 1 hour per day after the initial cleanup.

   Weekly Meeting: One hour with the owner.

   Position Type: Ongoing, part-time gig work.

   Growth Potential: Opportunity for continued work for someone who performs well. 



Actual hours may fluctuate depending on the amount of bookkeeping work and the progress of the initial cleanup.

    Time Tracking and Payment

    Payments will be made through Sendwave.

   You will be required to use a time-tracking application to record all working hours.

   Accurate time tracking is mandatory.

   A daily activity report must accompany your work.



Required Qualifications

   Applicants must meet the following requirements:

   Minimum of 2 years of professional QuickBooks Online experience.

   Previous real estate bookkeeping experience is preferred.

   Strong understanding of basic bookkeeping and accounting principles.

   Experience reconciling bank and credit card accounts.

   Experience categorizing financial transactions.

   Ability to review and organize an existing QuickBooks company file.

   Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities.

   Good written and spoken English.

   Reliable internet connection and a suitable computer.

   Ability to participate in a weekly one-hour meeting with the owner.

   Ability to work independently, meet expectations, and provide consistent daily updates.



How to Apply

To be considered, please include ALL of the following in your application:

   1. QuickBooks Online Experience

      Explain your bookkeeping background and specify exactly how many years you have worked professionally with                                 QuickBooks Online.

2. Relevant Bookkeeping Skills

Describe your experience with:

    Bank and credit card reconciliations.

   Categorizing income and expenses.

   Reviewing and correcting transaction classifications.

   Cleaning up and organizing an existing QuickBooks company file.

3. Resume

   Provide a link to your current resume (Google Drive or another accessible link).

4. Additional Experience

   Include any previous property management or residential leasing experience. Bonus points if you have worked with a real    estate investment company.

5. Availability

   Confirm that you can initially commit to approximately 2 hours per day and attend a weekly one-hour meeting with the owner.

6. Equipment and Internet

   Confirm that you have a reliable internet connection and a computer suitable for professional bookkeeping work.

7. Favorite Filipino Celebrity

   Include a photo of your favorite famous person from the Philippines. This is just a fun way for me to learn a little about you,    and it also helps verify that you have read the entire job posting.

Final Application Instructions

Use 4 Application Points when submitting your application.

Support employee engagement initiatives and internal communications.

Help coordinate performance reviews and employee feedback activities.

Assist in addressing workplace concerns and maintaining a positive work environment.

Handle sensitive employee matters professionally and confidentially.

Promote a positive, respectful, and collaborative workplace culture.

HR Compliance & Policy Support

Assist in implementing and maintaining company HR policies and procedures.

Ensure employee documentation and HR processes are properly maintained.

Support compliance with applicable employment laws and workplace regulations.

Assist with updating HR policies and employee handbooks when required.

Coordinate with management on HR-related compliance requirements.

Essential Qualifications:

Previous experience as an HR Officer, HR Generalist, HR Assistant, Recruitment Specialist, or similar HR position.

Strong knowledge of recruitment, onboarding, and general HR administration.

Experience handling employee records, HR documentation, and confidential information.

Good understanding of HR processes, employee relations, and workplace policies.

High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and manage multiple HR responsibilities.

Comfortable working with Australian business hours and remote teams.

Additional Experience (An Advantage):

Experience working with Australian companies or international clients.

Familiarity with Australian employment practices and Fair Work requirements.

Experience with HR management systems (HRIS) and recruitment platforms.

Knowledge of payroll coordination and employee benefits administration.

Experience developing HR policies, procedures, and employee handbooks.

Background in performance management and employee engagement initiatives.

Experience supporting remote or offshore teams.



Important: We prioritise candidates with solid hands-on HR experience, particularly in recruitment, employee management, and HR administration. Candidates do not need to be experts in every area of human resources, but should have a good understanding of HR operations, strong communication skills, and the ability to handle employee matters professionally and independently.



To Apply

If you're a proactive and people-oriented HR professional who enjoys supporting employees, managing recruitment, and helping businesses build effective teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Website:

Study recent posts that are still visible and earned strong upvotes or substantive comments. Disclose your affiliation when promoting Ennichi and follow each community’s rules.

 & Collaboration.

title: Part-Time Zoho Ecosystem Specialist & Accountant (10 hrs/week)
description:
Skills Required:  Bookkeeping, Account Reconciliation, Zoho Expertise



This role will be responsible for processing new clients assuring correct set-up in Zoho CRM / Books / Billing.  Also they will be responsible for categorizing any transactions and tracking payments and payroll hours. 



About 30% of the time we will work on new enhancements to our ZOHO account and you will need to have expertise in customizing the platform.



About Red Raven

Our History: Red Raven AI is a fast-growing start-up with about 18 months in business. We have a very simple accounting process. We have only 2 credit card accounts with about 20 recurring charges. All of our revenue comes from recurring credit card billing. We have about 20 revenue transactions a month. We reconcile each month. As part of this job we will be moving to Zoho Books from Quick Books. You must be able to fully handle that transition.



Our Culture: At Red Raven, we value autonomy, clear communication, and a growth mindset. We don't micromanage; instead, we look for proactive problem-solvers who take ownership of their work. Even though we are a small team, we move fast, value tech-forward solutions, and appreciate a touch of creativity in everything we do.



Position Overview

Are you a Zoho wizard who also happens to understand numbers? Red Raven is looking for a part-time Zoho Ecosystem Specialist with an accounting background to help us streamline our operations.



Our accounting needs are incredibly straightforward and will only take a fraction of your time. The real magic of this role lies in your ability to build, connect, and optimize our Zoho One suite. If you love setting up workflows, organizing databases, and making different software modules talk to each other seamlessly, this role is for you.



Hours: ~10 hours per week (Flexible, but requires a few overlapping hours for syncs) We DO NOT require U.S.A. time zone hours. You are free to work your normal hours. 



Type: Part-time, Remote (Freelance/Contract)



Key Responsibilities

1. Zoho Ecosystem Setup & Optimization (30%)



Zoho CRM & Billing: Build out pipelines, custom fields, and automate client onboarding.



Zoho Books & Desk: Set up our accounting backend and help configure Zoho Desk for customer ticketing/support.



Zoho Projects: Organize our project management templates to ensure client deliverables are tracked efficiently.



Integrations: Ensure data flows correctly between all Zoho modules and external tools (like Stripe).



2. Simple Accounting & Reconciliation (70%)

Reconcile one company credit card (approximately 10 transactions per month).



Track and reconcile incoming client payments via Stripe (approximately 20 clients paying by credit card).



Ensure Zoho Books remains clean, accurate, and up-to-date.



Required Qualifications

Proven Zoho Expertise: Deep familiarity with the Zoho One ecosystem, specifically Zoho CRM, Books, Projects, Billing, and Desk.



Accounting/Bookkeeping Background: You understand general ledger principles, reconciliations, and how to keep books audit-ready (even simple ones!).



Tech-Savvy Tech Stack: Experience dealing with Stripe integrations is highly preferred.



To prove you have great attention to detail, please start your application with the words: "Red Raven Zoho Wizard found!"



Proactive Communicator: Since this is a 10-hour-a-week role, you need to be a self-starter who can update us on progress without needing constant reminders.



Excellent written and spoken English.



How to Apply

If you are ready to help Red Raven scale our backend operations, please reply with:



A brief summary of your experience with the Zoho One ecosystem (please highlight which modules you are strongest in).



A quick overview of your accounting/bookkeeping background.



Your hourly rate.

title: Real Estate VP Technology Strategy and Innovation
description:
Reports to CEO and President

Works closely with the VP of Technology Operations and Systems Integration and Lead Management team; Operations; Agent Services; Marketing; Compliance; Finance; and external technology partners



Position Overview

YLN is creating this role to own both technology direction and portfolio delivery for its next stage of growth. The VP will translate the 2027 growth plan into an executable roadmap for platforms, data, AI, automation, security, staffing, and

investment. The role is accountable for priorities, capacity decisions, delivery commitments, and measurable business

results across the technology portfolio.



Role Distinction

This role has final accountability for enterprise technology priorities and delivery outcomes. Within approved budgets and

executive direction, the VP sets the roadmap, target architecture, sequence, deadlines, and capacity requirements. Zohaib

directs the team's daily work and assigns resources to approved priorities. When demand exceeds capacity, Zohaib

presents the constraint and options; this VP d
 what moves, what pauses, and what staffing is needed, escalating

budget or headcount decisions to the CEO and President.



Core Responsibilities and Area Accountability

1. 2027 Growth Roadmap - Own a multi-year roadmap tied to growth and revenue goals, with named owners, deadlines, dependencies, capacity, and staffing assumptions. Review delivery performance regularly and make timely priority or resource decisions when commitments are at risk.

2. Scalable Technology Stack - Own target architecture across Zillow Pro, Follow Up Boss, Ylopo, eRelocation, Biloco, and future tools. Before approval, assess effects on other departments, existing workflows, reporting, permissions, costs, support, and the agent and client experience.

3. AI and Automation - Work with department leaders to identify high-burden manual processes and prioritize practical AI or automation. Define the baseline, expected benefit, controls, owner, and adoption plan; check back after launch to confirm the change solved the problem.

4. Data Quality and Analytics - Own data definitions, reporting requirements, executive dashboards, and reporting priorities. Set standards and accountability for accurate, timely reports; use results to guide routing, nurture, staffing, and investment decisions while Zohaib owns report production and delivery.

5. Agent and Client Growth - Design technology that strengthens onboarding, partner service, agent productivity, and retention. Involve affected teams before changes are made, plan training and support, and validate afterward that workflows and the agent or client experience improved.

6. Vendor Governance and Budget - Own platform selection, contracts, strategic vendor calls, technology budget, licensing

policy, service levels, security, and vendor risk. Maintain accountability for technology spend and billing controls; Zohaib manages support calls, usage records, and invoice validation.

7. Cross Functional Leadership - Set portfolio priorities and delivery standards, direct work through the approved roadmap,

and hold leaders accountable for commitments. Lead impact reviews with Operations, Agent Services, Marketing, Compliance, Finance, and other teams before and after material changes.



Qualifications

• Senior technology leadership experience in a growing, lead-driven organization, with accountability for strategy,

architecture, budgets, staffing, vendors, and delivery results.

• Demonstrated success with CRM, marketing technology, multi-client environments, and API-based integrations;

experience with Follow Up Boss, Zillow, Ylopo, or eRelocation is strongly preferred.

• Practical experience deploying AI and automation with baselines, controls, adoption plans, and measurable results.

• Strong command of data governance, reporting, analytics, cybersecurity, privacy, access management, and change

governance.

• Clear executive communication and the ability to resolve competing priorities, capacity constraints, and cross-functional

impacts.

• Real estate, relocation, mortgage, or agent-network experience is preferred. A bachelor's degree in technology,

business, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is expected.

Success Measures

• A prioritized 2027 roadmap is actively managed with owners, deadlines, capacity, staffing assumptions, and clear

escalation paths.

• Portfolio commitments are delivered predictably, and capacity conflicts are resolved through explicit reprioritization,

staffing, or executive decisions.

• At least one high-burden manual process is improved within 90 days, with a documented baseline and measurable

result.

• Affected departments confirm that material changes improve workflows, reporting, permissions, or the agent and client

experience.

• Executive and recurring reports have defined owners, standards, schedules, and reliable source data.

• Technology vendors, contracts, billing, licensing, security, and access risks are reviewed on schedule and acted upon.

title: HR Specialist
description:
Role Type

Within Philippines • Contract • Part-time • Associate



Love keeping things organised and running smoothly behind the scenes? Enjoy helping people and making their experience at work a great one? Curious about digital tools and always looking for smarter, simpler ways of working? And have a soft spot for great coffee and sustainability?



If you said yes to all, then keep reading!





First up: We want this to be a great place to work – that’s our commitment to everyone on our team. It won’t always be easy, but it will be fulfilling. You’ll learn and grow, surrounded by a team that genuinely cares about our mission and about helping each other get there.

A little about You

You’ll be the supporting hand that keeps the HR team ticking along behind the scenes. Working closely with our HR Coordinator, you’ll support our day-to-day (BAU) HR operations – helping welcome new team members, keeping leave and HR trackers up to date, running team surveys and reviews, sending HR comms, and making sure our systems and SOPs are tidy and working smoothly.



You should be naturally organised, love a good checklist, and take pride in getting the details right. You’re comfortable with digital tools, curious about finding smarter ways of working, and someone the team can trust with confidential information. Most of all, you enjoy helping people and want every team member experiences at P&R to be a great one!





About Us

Pablo & Rusty’s is a specialty coffee roaster based in Sydney, with a mission to positively impact people and the planet through coffee. We’re one of the few coffee companies in Australia that are B Corp Certified, Carbon Neutral, and members of 1% for the Planet.



We’re a digital, design-centric, and sustainable company. Innovation drives everything we do, and we always look for ways to improve. We have high expectations of our team members and work collaboratively to achieve our goals.



👀 Are you still here?

 In your cover letter, tell us your go-to coffee order and one HR or admin task you’d love to make simpler. We’ll be looking out for it!



About the Role

We are looking for a part-time HR/Administrative Assistant to join our Human Potential (HR/HP) team on a 1-year fixed-term contract. This is a support role, working closely with our HR Coordinator to help keep our business-as-usual (BAU) HR operations running smoothly. You’ll also help look after our HR processes and automations, keeping workflows, trackers and SOPs up to date and spotting ways to make things simpler for the team. This is a high-trust role, so handling confidential information with care is a must. There is potential to extend the contract beyond 1 year or transition into a permanent role, depending on business needs and performance.





Key duties and responsibilities:

• Coordinate onboarding for new team members

• Support recruitment admin such as posting job ads, coordinating interviews and drafting offer letters and contracts

• Monitor performance reviews (Quarterlies, Anniversaries, Probation)

• Help run HR activities such as Team Surveys and annual EEO training

• Maintain the leave tracker and employee benefits records

• Monitor HR inbox, respond to
s and team queries, and follow up on requests in a timely manner

• Keep employee records and trackers accurate, manage HR filing, and coordinate recurring monthly HR activities

• Help streamline and automate recurring HR tasks





Qualifications and knowledge:

• At least 1–2 years of experience in an HR, people operations or administrative support role

• Experience using Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Outlook, Docs and Excel); familiarity or experience with Power Automate is a plus

• Experience or familiarity with Employment Hero or any similar HR tracking system

• Comfortable working with digital systems and open to exploring new tools, including AI, to help streamline everyday processes (you don’t need to be an expert, just curious and willing to learn as we go 😉)

• Strong organisation and attention to detail, with clear written and verbal English

• Able to work independently across time zones and handle sensitive information with discretion

• With your own reliable computer/laptop and stable high-speed internet, plus a backup connection and power source as needed





Work schedule

Part-time, fixed-term contract (1 year), 25 hours per week (5hrs a day, Monday to Friday), working afternoon shifts in Sydney time (AEST/AEDT).





Sounds like your cup of coffee?

Send us your resume and cover letter (please include “HR Coffee” in your subject line - attention to detail is a big part of the role 😉)

title: Medical Administrative Service Provider (Nonclinical) — U.S. Mental Health Practices
description:
Medical Administrative Service Provider (Nonclinical) — U.S. Mental Health Practices

Zocdoc booking review, patient intake, scheduling and EHR administrative entry

Company: Exxceed Wellness Inc. (California, USA) — a telehealth psychiatric practice

Engagement type: Independent service provider under a written agreement with Exxceed Wellness Inc., supporting the practice's own front desk

Location: Philippines — remote, from a private home office

Openings: 2

Start: [Insert anticipated start date]

Hours: Part-time to full-time, typically 20 to 40 hours per week, scheduled in advance

Schedule: Service blocks fall inside 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 midnight U.S. Pacific Time (Manila: midnight to 4:00 p.m.), seven days a week. You tell us your weekly availability; we offer blocks that fit it.

About Exxceed Wellness Inc.

Exxceed Wellness Inc. is a California psychiatric practice providing telehealth evaluation and medication management, TMS and other mental health services. Our front desk runs on a small Philippine-based administrative team: new-patient booking review, intake coordination, scheduling, insurance-eligibility checks and administrative data entry in our electronic health record (eClinicalWorks). You would join that team and contract directly with the practice. This posting is for our own vacancies, not for placement with any other company.

We are a small, privacy-first practice and we are looking for two dependable, long-term medical administrative service providers who already know U.S. healthcare admin work.

What you will do

During a service block you perform nonclinical administrative tasks under the practice's written rules, such as:

• Monitor an approved Zocdoc booking queue and process eligible new-patient bookings, cancellations and reschedules.

• Send approved intake forms, consent forms, patient instructions and insurance-card requests through the practice's own systems.

• Search for existing patient records and prevent duplicate charts using the approved workflow.

• Create or update permitted demographic, insurance, appointment, intake-status and document-indexing fields in the EHR (eClinicalWorks or similar).

• Reconcile Zocdoc bookings with the EHR or scheduling calendar.

• Upload and index administrative documents (IDs, insurance cards, signed forms, referrals, authorizations).

• Run insurance eligibility and benefits checks when the work order authorizes them.

• Record task status, pending items and next steps in the secure task queue, and complete a secure handoff at the end of the block.

• Escalate incomplete information, duplicate-chart risks, schedule conflicts, safety messages and clinical questions to the practice under the written workflow — never guess.

What you will never do

This is strictly nonclinical. You will not give medical, mental-health, medication or insurance-coverage advice; perform triage, counseling or crisis response; write, edit or sign clinical notes; select or change diagnosis or billing codes, medications, allergies or orders; use a clinician's password, MFA code or electronic signature; or make clinical accept/reject decisions.

How the engagement works

• You sign the practice's Independent Service Provider Agreement, confidentiality agreement, privacy and security acknowledgment and a HIPAA business associate agreement before any system access.

• Work is scheduled in 8-hour service blocks by written work order, confirmed with you a week ahead.

• You invoice weekly for completed blocks; the practice pays within the period stated in the agreement.

• Training, the workflow exercise and onboarding are paid time.

• You may take other engagements, provided there is no conflict of interest and all confidential information stays protected.

• The practice keeps backup coverage within its own team for blocks that need to be transferred.

Required qualifications

• At least 2 years of recent experience in U.S. healthcare administration: medical virtual assistance, scheduling, patient intake, EHR support or insurance verification.

• Strong written and spoken English; clear, professional, empathetic communication.

• Experience with at least one EHR, practice-management, scheduling or patient-intake system.

• Accuracy with patient demographics, appointment data and insurance information, and the discipline to follow written workflows exactly and escalate instead of guessing.

• Willingness to complete HIPAA privacy and security training before access is granted.

• A private, quiet home office where no one else can see or hear patient information; a reliable computer with a current operating system, anti-malware and screen lock; MFA capability; reliable primary internet with a backup plan.

• Ability to issue a valid invoice and handle your own tax obligations in the Philippines.

Preferred

• Hands-on eClinicalWorks (eCW) experience.

• Zocdoc, patient portals, payer portals or U.S. behavioral-health practice experience.

• U.S. insurance eligibility and benefits verification, prior-authorization tracking, referrals or intake-document management.

• Prior HIPAA training or work for a U.S. covered entity or business associate.

• Experience with Pacific Time service commitments.

Privacy and security

This work may involve U.S. protected health information. You must use only your own named credentials and MFA; work only in approved systems and channels; never download, print, screenshot or store patient information outside approved systems; never use personal
, personal messaging, personal cloud storage or unapproved AI tools with patient or practice information; and report any suspected privacy or security incident immediately.

Pay

US$3.50 per hour, paid weekly on your invoice in Philippine pesos. Onboarding and training hours are paid at the same rate.

How to apply

Apply through this OnlineJobs.ph posting with:

• Your resume, including your U.S. healthcare administration experience.

• A short cover letter (under 250 words): your most relevant U.S. medical-admin experience, the EHR or practice-management systems you have used, and why a nonclinical, privacy-sensitive role suits you.

• Your weekly availability in Pacific Time, and whether you are open to weekend blocks.

• Put the phrase EXXCEED SECURE ADMIN in the first line of your application.

Please do not send patient information, screenshots from previous healthcare jobs, passwords or confidential documents from previous employers with your application, and do not send identification documents at this stage.

Selection process

• A video interview on the role, privacy and security practice, and nonclinical boundaries.

• A short administrative-workflow exercise using made-up data (about 30 minutes), paid at the hourly rate.

• For the selected providers: contract signing, paid HIPAA and security training, a brief secure-workspace check and paid onboarding before any system access. Identity and reference checks happen only at this stage, with your consent and only as the law allows.

Equal opportunity

Exxceed Wellness evaluates applicants on relevant experience, skills, communication, security readiness and reliability. Qualified applicants who can meet the role's requirements are welcome.

- Noting down what happened on every call

- Sending a short recap when your shift ends



PAY AND HOURS

- $5.00 USD an hour (around $1,040 a month)

- $3 extra for every appointment that shows up

- Room to increase your rate based on performance

- Paid twice a month

- Monday to Saturday, 8 hours a day

- 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern

  That's 10:00 PM - 6:00 AM Manila from November to March,

  and 9:00 PM - 5:00 AM Manila from March to November

- Full-time and long-term



If you're good at this and you stick around, there's room to move into training and hiring new setters as we grow.



WHAT YOU NEED

- 2+ years making outbound calls to U.S. customers (setting appointments, telemarketing, or sales)

- Fluent English with a clear, easy-to-understand accent (U.S. callers should understand you the first time)

- Your own laptop or desktop, Core i5 or better with 8GB RAM. Phones and tablets won't work.

- 25 Mbps or faster internet, and a second connection ready if it drops

- A way to keep working when the power goes out

- A noise-canceling USB headset and a quiet room

- No other job during our hours

- A working webcam & able to get on a Zoom call with your camera on (if needed)



NICE TO HAVE

- Final expense or mortgage protection calling experience

- Time on a dialer or CRM (GoHighLevel, Ringy, ReadyMode, etc)

- You've worked U.S. night shift before



YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF YOU

- Want to stay somewhere long-term instead of hopping jobs

- Can hear "no" all day and still sound good on the next call

- Like getting paid more when your appointments show up

- Are open to coaching and following a script



HOW HIRING WORKS

1. We go through applications and watch every video

2. You do a few paid trial shifts on real leads

3. If it's a fit, we make you a full-time offer



HOW TO APPLY

If you skip any of these steps, we won't review your application.



1. Start your application with the word LEGACY.



2. Send us a short video, 3 minutes or less, with your camera on. Record it where you'd actually work, with the headset you'd use. Upload it to Loom, YouTube (unlisted), or Google Drive and paste the link. Make sure we can open it. If you're not sure how to do any of this, figuring it out is part of the test.



In the video:

- Introduce yourself

- Tell us about your appointment setting experience, especially life insurance

- Tell us which dialers, CRMs, or other systems you've used

- Tell us how many appointments you usually set per day or per week, and your show rate if you know it

- Read this like it's a real call:



"Hi, is this Mary? Hi Mary, this is [your name] calling about the life insurance information you asked for. I'll be quick. I just want to set up a short call with our licensed agent so they can go over your options. Would tomorrow at 2 PM or Thursday at 10 AM work better for you?"



- Then pretend Mary says: "Just send me something in the mail." Show us what you'd say next. No script for this part.



3. In the message you send with your application, answer these:

- Can you work this shift, Monday to Saturday, for at least a year?

- Do you have another job right now?

- What do you do if the power or internet goes out?

- Run a speed test at speedtest.net and paste the link to your result

title: Operations Coordinator / Operations Admin
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented, organized, and proactive Operations Coordinator / Operations Admin to support the Purchasing Manager with ingredient ordering, supplier coordination, compliance documentation, and daily operational tasks.



The company operates four in-house brands and manages a high volume of private-label production, requiring exceptional organizational skills, accuracy, and consistent follow-through.



Strong proficiency in AI tools, particularly Google Gemini, is highly valued. The ideal candidate will know how to leverage AI to streamline administrative workflows, organize and analyze information, assist with documentation, improve productivity, and identify opportunities to make daily operations more efficient. Candidates must be comfortable using AI responsibly while verifying information for accuracy and maintaining the confidentiality of company and supplier data.



This role is critical to ensuring ingredient sourcing, supplier records, and certification documentation remain accurate, complete, organized, and audit-ready.



Key Responsibilities

Assist the Purchasing Manager with ingredient ordering across multiple brands and private-label production.

Track purchase orders, monitor delivery timelines, and follow up with suppliers to ensure timely fulfillment.

Maintain, organize, and update ingredient and supplier documentation, averaging approximately 30 documents per supplier.

Manage and validate third-party certifications, including:

Non-GMO

Kosher

Ensure all ingredient and supplier records are accurate, complete, current, and audit-ready.

Use AI tools such as Google Gemini to assist with document review, information organization, data analysis, drafting supplier communications, and streamlining repetitive administrative tasks.

Identify opportunities to use AI and digital tools to improve workflow efficiency, reduce manual work, and maintain consistency across records.

Verify AI-generated information against original documents and approved sources before updating records or making decisions.

Support general operational and administrative tasks related to purchasing, supply chain coordination, and documentation management.



Required Skill Sets

AI proficiency: Hands-on experience using Google Gemini or comparable AI tools to support administrative, analytical, and organizational tasks.

Strong attention to detail: Ability to identify missing information, inconsistencies, expired certifications, and documentation errors.

Exceptional organizational skills: Ability to manage large volumes of files, records, and deadlines across multiple brands and suppliers.

Documentation and file management: Comfortable maintaining structured, accurate, and easily accessible digital records.

Process-oriented mindset: Able to follow established procedures, maintain consistency, and improve workflows when appropriate.

Proactive problem-solving: Resourceful, quick to learn, and able to anticipate issues and take initiative.

Independent work ethic: Comfortable managing priorities and completing assignments with minimal supervision.

Communication skills: Clear, professional written and verbal communication when coordinating with suppliers and internal teams.

Technology adaptability: Willingness to learn new systems, software, and AI-powered tools to improve work performance.



Nice to Have

Experience in food manufacturing, consumer packaged goods (CPG), purchasing, or supply chain operations.

Familiarity with food ingredient documentation and third-party certifications.

Experience coordinating with vendors, suppliers, or purchasing teams.

Experience with spreadsheets, ERP systems, inventory management software, or document management platforms.

Experience using AI tools to summarize documents, extract information, compare records, organize data, or automate repetitive administrative tasks.



How to apply:

Appy to this job post with a short cover letter including the link to your updated resume and introduction video.

YOU GET

title: PODCAST PRODUCTION ASSISTANT | REMOTE
description:
**Job Type:** Part-Time Freelance / Ongoing  

**Starting Pay:** $100 USD per month  

**Workload:** 3 podcast episodes per month  

**Location:** Remote  

**Experience:** Preferred, but not required  

**Opportunity for Growth and Increased Pay**



### ABOUT THE POSITION



We are looking for a creative, organized, and tech-savvy Podcast Production Assistant to join the **She Is Made For More Podcast** team!



She Is Made For More is a growing women's community and lifestyle brand with a podcast featuring conversations about entrepreneurship, personal growth, motherhood, relationships, leadership, and building a life you love.



We already have an established podcast production process, templates, and tools in place. We're looking for someone who can step in, learn our workflow, and help us prepare each episode for publishing.



You do not need to be an experienced podcast editor to apply. We're open to beginners who are willing to learn, experiment, follow instructions, and take initiative.



### WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



**1. Podcast Audio Editing**



Our host will record each podcast episode through Riverside.



Your responsibility will be to:



- Access the recorded episode in Riverside.

- Edit the conversation to create a clean, professional audio recording.

- Add our provided podcast intro and outro.

- Make sure the audio flows naturally and is ready for publishing.

- Export and deliver the completed episode as an MP3 file.



**2. Podcast Video Clips**



Using Riverside, you will:



- Review the episode and identify engaging moments that could perform well on social media.

- Use Riverside's built-in clip generation and editing tools.

- Select and prepare 2 short-form video clips per episode.

- Make sure the clips are clean, engaging, and ready for Instagram Reels.

- Deliver the finished clips for our team to review and post.



Additional video editing experience is a plus, but not required.



**3. Podcast Show Notes**



Riverside automatically generates a transcript for every episode.



Using the transcript and our existing templates, you will:



- Create a compelling episode title suggestion.

- Write a short podcast description and show notes.

- Prepare the content so it is ready to copy and paste into Buzzsprout.



You are welcome to use ChatGPT or other AI tools to assist with drafting and organizing the content.



**4. Podcast
 Preparation**



We already have an established
 template for promoting new podcast episodes.



Your responsibility will be to:



- Use the episode transcript to understand the conversation.

- Follow our existing
 template.

- Write and prepare the episode announcement
.

- Include the episode highlights and key takeaways.

- Submit the completed
 copy for our team to review and upload into Kajabi.



You will not be responsible for sending
s or publishing podcast episodes at this stage.



### WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER FOR EACH EPISODE



For each of the two monthly episodes, we expect:



- One fully edited MP3 podcast episode, including intro and outro.

- 2  edited short-form video clips.

- Podcast show notes and a suggested episode title.

- One podcast announcement
 using our existing template.



All materials should be organized and delivered together for review.



### WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for someone who is:



- Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new software.

- Creative and able to recognize interesting moments in a conversation.

- Organized and attentive to detail.

- Comfortable following templates and instructions.

- Willing to learn Riverside and experiment with its features.

- Comfortable using ChatGPT to assist with writing and content preparation.

- Reliable with deadlines and communication.

- Open to feedback and willing to make improvements.



**Experience with Riverside, podcast editing, Canva, ChatGPT, or other content creation tools is a plus, but not required.**



We're happy to work with someone who is brand new to podcast production but has a willingness to learn and grow.



### COMPENSATION & WORKLOAD



**Starting Pay: $100 USD per month**



This position will begin with two podcast episodes per month.



We already have templates, brand assets, podcast introductions, outros, and an established workflow to make the process easier.



As the podcast grows, there will be opportunities to take on additional episodes, expand responsibilities, and increase compensation.



### OPPORTUNITY FOR GROWTH



Our long-term goal is to find someone who can eventually take ownership of more of the podcast production process.



Future responsibilities may include podcast publishing, social media content preparation, episode scheduling, and additional creative projects.



We would love to build a long-term working relationship with someone who is excited to grow alongside the She Is Made For More brand.



### HOW TO APPLY



If you're creative, tech-savvy, eager to learn, and excited about helping bring a podcast to life, we'd love to hear from you!



Please apply through this job posting and share a little about yourself, your experience, and why you're interested in the position.



**We'd also love to see examples of your previous work!** If you have a portfolio, video editing samples, Instagram Reels, TikToks, podcast clips, or any other content you've edited, please include them with your application.



We're especially interested in seeing your creativity when it comes to short-form video editing, as creating engaging clips that showcase our podcast conversations will be an important part of this role.



Previous podcast experience is not required. We're open to beginners who are willing to learn, take initiative, and grow with our brand.



### TRIAL PERIOD



Applicants selected to move forward will complete a **paid trial period** before being offered an ongoing position.



During this period, you'll have the opportunity to work with our existing podcast workflow, familiarize yourself with Riverside, and complete assigned podcast production tasks.



This will give us an opportunity to evaluate your creativity, communication, attention to detail, and ability to follow our process, while also giving you a chance to see if the position is a good fit for you.



Our goal is to find someone we can build a long-term working relationship with as the She Is Made For More Podcast continues to grow!







**She Is Made For More Team**

, Instagram and

### Who We're Looking For



We're not looking for someone who simply follows instructions, sends generic messages or waits to be told what to do next.



We want someone who:



- Is genuinely confident in their sales and business development abilities

- Has a proactive, results-driven mindset

- Can identify opportunities without being directed

- Understands the difference between collecting contacts and generating qualified leads

- Can build rapport and communicate naturally with potential clients

- Is comfortable initiating conversations with business owners

- Can develop, test and improve their own outreach strategies

- Takes ownership of their performance and results

- Is highly organised and capable of managing multiple conversations and opportunities simultaneously

- Is resourceful, commercially aware and willing to learn our industry

- Can work with minimal supervision and consistently deliver results



**Most importantly, we need someone who can independently generate genuine business opportunities and put qualified, interested prospects in front of our General Manager.**

 and business communication accounts

title: Executive assistant
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

Net Value Partners (NetVP) · Fully remote · Philippines



ABOUT NET VALUE PARTNERS



Net Value Partners (NetVP) is a technology department — an entire technology organization that operates as part of a client's business, not a vendor beside it. Built with an executive strategy layer at the top and six specialized functions beneath it — Cybersecurity, Network Operations, User Support, Project Delivery, Technology Supply Chain, and Business Intelligence & AI — we cover every layer of technology a growing business depends on, and we stay accountable for the outcomes, not just the activity. Our mission is to turn technology into momentum for the businesses we serve.



What makes us different is depth. We don't do a little for many — we do a lot for a few. We deliberately partner with a small number of growing, multi-location businesses in operations-critical industries and go deep into their environments, their processes, and their goals. That focus only works when the department behind it runs in order: decisions tracked, commitments kept, and every function moving together.



That model only works with the right people, so this is how we build our team. We hire for the long term and invest in people who want to grow with us. When our name is on the work, we own it, and every function is named, measured, and accountable. We expect a lot, we support each other, and we operate as one coordinated department rather than a collection of individual roles.



We're headquartered in Naples, Florida, and remote-first. We hold ourselves to a clear set of standards in how we work: excellence as a baseline, continuous improvement, customer-centric decisions, integrity in every action, and strategic, long-term thinking. If you're looking for a place to go deep, build mastery, and stay for the long haul, you'll fit here.



ROLE OVERVIEW



As our Executive Assistant, you keep the leadership layer and the department behind it moving. You capture what is d
 in meetings, track who owns what and by when, follow up until it's done, and keep the Chief of Staff and CEO current on where everything stands. You are the person the team can count on to close the loop.



This is a people-first role for someone who is organized, warm, and genuinely easy to work with: clear in writing, calm on calls, and disciplined behind the scenes. You'll work with every function lead, so you need to be someone people are glad to hear from — even when you're the one asking for a status.



You report to the Chief of Staff and support the CEO directly. Your day-to-day rhythm is with the Chief of Staff; the CEO's calendar, commitments, and follow-ups are part of what you keep moving. This is a single seat covering both, not a team.



This role is internal. You will not handle client calls, client tickets, or client communication — that belongs to our User Support function. You'll receive defined procedures to execute, not abstract topics to figure out, and responsibility grows as trust does.



This is a fully remote, work-from-home position based in the Philippines.



This is a full-time, dedicated position. We're hiring one person for NetVP only. If you currently support other clients or employers, this role requires you to close those engagements before starting.



EMPLOYMENT DETAILS



Work setup: Fully remote (work from home), Philippines

Commitment: Full-time, dedicated to NetVP; no concurrent clients or employers

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST (10-hour shift with 1-hour unpaid lunch). A traditional 8-hour window within these hours is available.

Compensation: Based on experience

Reports to: Chief of Staff, supporting the CEO

Trial period: 90 days



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



Meeting Capture & Commitment Tracking

- Attend leadership and function meetings; record decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.

- Maintain the action-item tracker as the single record of open commitments across the department.

- Send follow-ups on schedule and keep items moving until they are closed, not just assigned.

- Deliver a weekly status summary to the Chief of Staff and CEO: what closed, what's open, what's at risk.



Function Lead Collaboration

- Hold standing touchpoints with function leads on their open items and upcoming deadlines.

- Surface blockers and slipping dates early, before they reach leadership as surprises.

- Keep cross-function items from stalling between owners.

- Build relationships with the team so follow-ups are welcomed, not avoided.



Team Organization & Rhythm

- Check timesheets in ConnectWise before the end of each work week and follow up with anyone behind.

- Run onboarding and offboarding checklists for new and departing team members.

- Prepare and post internal announcements in Teams as directed.

- Pull recurring reports on schedule and distribute them to the right people.



Initiative Execution

- Execute defined procedures handed off by the Chief of Staff, such as LinkedIn post batches, tracker upkeep, and formatting documents to template.

- Maintain prospect and contact lists: cleanup, deduplication, and loading leads into Dynamics 365.

- Keep internal trackers and reference sheets current and accurate.

- Propose improvements to procedures you run once you know them well.



Executive Calendar & Inbox

- Manage the Chief of Staff's and CEO's calendars: scheduling, conflicts, and confirmations.

- Prepare meeting materials and send them the business day before.

- Triage designated inboxes: flag, sort, and route. Drafting replies is added as trust is established.

- Schedule calls with partners and vendors when asked.

- Submit your own timesheet accurately and on time each work period.



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS



- Action items logged within one business day of the meeting.

- Follow-ups sent on schedule; no open item without a next touch date.

- Weekly status delivered to the Chief of Staff and CEO on time.

- Timesheets complete across the team before the end of each work week.

- Calendar accuracy: no double-bookings; meeting materials sent the business day before.

- Tracker and list accuracy.



QUALIFICATIONS



Required

- Excellent written and spoken English, with a warm, professional presence on calls and in writing.

- 2+ years in an executive assistant or administrative support role with recurring deadlines and deliverables.

- Daily, working fluency in Microsoft 365: Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.

- A demonstrated record of follow-through — you have run a tracker, checklist, or follow-up system and can describe it.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; comfortable keeping many small items moving at once.

- A person people find genuinely easy to work with.



Preferred

- Basic understanding of common IT issues 
, MFA, permissions, connectivity).

- Experience in an MSP, NOC, or IT service environment.

- Familiarity with Microsoft 365 administration and its common user-facing issues.

- Hands-on experience with ConnectWise PSA or a comparable PSA/ticketing platform.

- Experience with Dynamics 365 or another CRM.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal Executive Assistant is organized, approachable, and steady. They take a defined task and see it through without being reminded, keep leadership current without being asked, and treat clean records and clear follow-ups as the job itself — not an afterthought. They are good at executing what's been laid out, and once they know a procedure well, they see what would make it better.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your resume and application to: 

Subject line: Hire Me – Executive Assistant



In your application, please answer these two questions:

1. Our hours are 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST, which is roughly 8:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time. What do you see as the biggest challenges of working this night shift long-term, and how have you handled them before?

2. A written description of one tracker, checklist, or follow-up system you have run — what it tracked, how you kept it current, and how you handled items that slipped.



Please also confirm that you have no other active clients or employers, or state when those engagements end. All new team members complete a 90-day trial and training period before transitioning to regular status.



Net Value Partners · Your Technology Partner in Value Creation ·
