FULL-TIME BOOKKEEPER & FINANCE OPERATIONS SPECIALIST

Remote | Multi-Entity | AI-Assisted | Direct Hire



About Us

From Military to Millionaire helps service members and veterans build financial freedom through real estate, entrepreneurship, and financial literacy. We are a veteran-led education and community business with 1,300+ members and related real estate businesses.



Our core values are Trustworthy, Connected, Creative, Show Don’t Tell, and People Over Money.



About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced bookkeeper to maintain accurate, current books for our education business and related real estate companies.



You’ll work with QuickBooks Online and Claude, our AI assistant, to categorize transactions, reconcile accounts, calculate commissions, and prepare reports. You are responsible for checking AI output and ensuring every number is accurate.



This is a bookkeeping and finance operations role. Financial strategy stays with leadership, and tax preparation and advice stay with our CPA.



Responsibilities

Daily:

- Categorize bank, credit card, PayPal, Whop, and Stripe transactions in QuickBooks Online.

- Record new sales in our commission tracker and verify customers and cash received.

- Track payment plans and confirm required recurring subscriptions are active.

- Flag unusual transactions, duplicate charges, failed payments, or suspected fraud promptly.



Weekly:

- Prepare a one-page cash report covering account balances, collections, outstanding payment plans, and upcoming bills.

- Prepare bill and contractor payment batches for CEO approval and release.

- Update financial metrics on our company scorecard.



Monthly:

- Reconcile all bank, credit card, PayPal, and payment-processor clearing accounts to a $0 difference by business day 5.

- Reconcile intercompany balances.

- Deliver cash-basis Profit & Loss statements and Balance Sheets for each entity by business day 10, with a short explanation of changes.

- Calculate sales commissions on net cash collected after refunds, ready for CEO review by the 3rd.

- Verify annual-to-monthly membership billing transitions.

- Update revenue, CAC, LTV, churn, and ROAS metrics with AI assistance.



Ongoing:

- Prepare quarterly and year-end financial packages for our CPA.

- Collect contractor W-9s and prepare 1099 filing data.

- Document recurring processes with clear instructions and screenshots.

- Maintain and improve AI instructions and reporting templates.



You will prepare payments; the CEO approves and releases them.



Required Qualifications

- At least 3 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience for US businesses using QuickBooks Online.

- QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification. Include a link to your certificate.

- Strong accounting fundamentals, including reconciliations, month-end close, debits and credits, and cash versus accrual accounting.

- Experience maintaining books for multiple related entities and recording intercompany transactions.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and cleaning exports.

- Clear written and spoken English, including occasional calls with vendors or payment processors.

- Strong integrity, discretion, attention to detail, and ownership of deadlines.

- Comfortable using AI tools or willing to learn—and committed to independently checking their output.

Preferred Experience

- Real estate bookkeeping, rental properties, hospitality, or property manager reports.

- Sales commissions and payment plans.

- Whop, Stripe, GoHighLevel, Wise, Digits, or similar platforms.

- Accounting degree or CPA qualification.



Compensation and Schedule

- $1,400 - $1,800 USD per month, based on experience.

- 40 hours per week.

- At least 4 hours of overlap with US Central Time on weekdays.

- Flexible/unlimited PTO.

- Remote direct hire, with no agency fees.

- Company-provided Claude Team seat.



How to Apply

Send your application through OnlineJobs.ph using this subject:

Bad Ass Bookkeeper — [Your Name]

Include:

1. Your résumé.

2. A link to your QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certificate.

3. Your results from this free DISC assessment:

description:
We run a recurring Meetup event series — webinars, presentations, and live sessions — teaching small business owners how to use AI and delegation to get about 20 hours a week back. Events run as an ongoing series (session 1, 2, 3, 4…), and many of the same people attend more than one. The goal of every event is the same: turn attendees into booked discovery calls with the founder.



This role owns everything that happens around those events — hosting them live, keeping the community warm between sessions, and making sure the numbers get tracked honestly. You'll also work directly on the content side, using Claude to build and refine presentations under the founder's established deck rules.



What You'll Own

Open the room, work the chat, keep energy up, close strong on the booking CTA

Manage the tech on the day — Meetup, Zoom / Google Meet, slides, audio, screen share

Use Claude to draft and refine event decks under the founder's standing deck rules and palette

Iterate fast on feedback and ship clean slides in time for each event

Manage the Meetup group end-to-end: event listings, attendee comms, reminders, descriptions

Keep repeat attendees engaged between sessions

Run follow-up outreach to warm leads, no-shows, and interested attendees



Tracking what matters



Keep a clean, honest record of attendees per session, repeat attendees, and no-shows

Track booked appointments and attendance rate (your commission depends on it)

Send the founder a short weekly report: attendance, bookings, show-up rate, trends



Workflow & operations



Build and maintain smooth workflows for event ops (setup, reminders, follow-ups)

Use Claude to automate drafting, templating, and reporting wherever it helps

Keep the founder's time focused on presenting, not logistics

Who You Are

2+ years hosting live events, webinars, or community sessions. You're comfortable on camera, on mic, and in chat — all at once.

Strong Claude / AI user. You can prompt Claude to produce real work: polished presentations,
 drafts, workflow automations. Not a dabbler.

Organized. You track attendance, bookings, and follow-ups without being chased.

Clear communicator. Written English is professional. Spoken English is confident enough to co-host or MC when needed.

Reliable on schedule. Available 9am–5pm EST, Monday to Friday. Core hours matter because events run live.

Bonus: experience with 
, Zoom webinars, Calendly, and small-business audiences.

 (event listings and community)

title: Part-Time Remote Writer / Reporter – Local News
description:
About us

We’re an independent, US-based local publication covering the people, policy and everyday life of the communities we serve. We’re a small newsroom, so every writer’s work shows up on the site and matters. We care about getting the story right and giving credit where it’s due, and we report the stories larger outlets tend to miss. This is a part-time, fully remote role with a flexible schedule.



About the role

We’re looking for a writer who can do two kinds of work: short, well-sourced daily news reports, and deeper original reporting built on interviews, documents and research. You’ll pitch stories, contact sources, write clean copy on deadline and help make our coverage something readers trust and come back to. We’ve built an in-house newsroom tool to help with this. Paste in a news link and it gives you suggested story angles, interview questions, a list of sources and their contact information, so you can spend less time on legwork and more time reporting and writing.



What you’ll do



Write short daily news reports that summarize other outlets’ stories, with clear credit and a link back to the original

Report and write original stories using interviews, public records and community features

Pitch story ideas on local government, public policy, education, the environment and the people behind the news

Contact sources, schedule interviews and follow up on your own stories

Fact-check your own work and help correct errors quickly and openly

Track your assignments, deadlines and source outreach in our newsroom dashboard



What we’re looking for



Strong news writing with clear, flowing prose and a good ear for a lede

A solid grasp of attribution: you know how to credit another outlet’s reporting, quote accurately and paraphrase in your own words

Working knowledge of AP style

Comfort with interviewing people, from public officials to community members with a story to tell

Reliability on daily deadlines and the ability to work independently

Curiosity about local communities and the people in them

At least one year of reporting or writing experience, or a strong portfolio from student media, freelancing or a blog



Nice to have



Experience with WordPress or another CMS

Familiarity with public records and reading government documents

Photography or basic multimedia skills

Knowledge of US local news and government



Our standards

Every story is written by a person. Writers may use AI tools for research and routine tasks, but not to write their stories. When we draw on another outlet’s work, we name them, link to them and keep our summaries short so readers can get the full story from the original source.



Details



Type: Part-time. You’re free to work with other clients as long as your daily deliverables are met.

Location: Remote

Pay: Starts at ₱15,000 per month, with an increase possible after three months based on a performance review

Schedule: Flexible. Work on your own schedule, as long as your daily deliverables are met.



How to apply

 with a short introduction and links to your previous work. Articles published by a news outlet are preferred but not required.

Selected candidates will be required to complete a test project before we make a final decision. The test project will be modestly paid. Applications without past social video ad examples will not be considered.

title: CRM go high level manager
description:
NOW HIRING: GoHighLevel CRM Manager



Asset Recovery Agents of America LLC



Location: Remote – Philippines

Position: Part-Time CRM Manager / GoHighLevel Specialist

Starting Pay: $1.61 USD per hour (Firm and Nonnegotiable)

Regular Schedule: Monday–Friday, 4 hours per day, 20 hours per week

Weekly Base Pay: $32.20 USD

Additional Earnings: 5% of qualifying company net profits

Payday: Every Friday, Colorado USA time

Payment Method: Remitly (GCash accepted)



1. About Our Company



Asset Recovery Agents of America LLC is a growing United States-based surplus funds recovery company.



Our business specializes in locating individuals who may be entitled to surplus funds remaining after foreclosure sales.



We work with a team of virtual assistants who contact potential clients and heirs to help identify individuals who may be entitled to these funds.



We are looking for an experienced, reliable, and knowledgeable GoHighLevel CRM Manager who can help us repair, configure, organize, and maintain our existing CRM system.



This position offers flexible working hours, long-term employment potential, and additional earnings through our company's 5% net-profit bonus program.



We are a small company with plans for continued growth, and we are looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



2. Initial CRM Evaluation and Setup – First Week



Our immediate priority is to get our existing GoHighLevel CRM account fully operational.



We currently have one GoHighLevel sub-account through Excess Elite.



We do not intend to purchase multiple sub-accounts for our cold-calling workers.



During the first week, the selected CRM Manager will be responsible for evaluating our existing account and determining whether our requested setup can be accomplished.



We understand that this initial setup may require additional working hours.



We are willing to pay for additional approved hours during the first week to get the CRM properly configured, tested, and operational.



Your initial responsibilities will include:



1. Review our existing GoHighLevel account and identify problems with current settings, workflows, and automations.

2. Repair or modify existing automations as necessary.

3. Configure three individual cold-calling VA accounts within our one existing sub-account.

4. Set up one dedicated business phone number for each cold-calling VA.

5. Configure automatic equal lead distribution among the three workers.

6. Create separate calling queues so each VA can work independently.

7. Expand our existing three-round calling process into five rounds.

8. Configure approved automated text and
 campaigns.

9. Evaluate and adjust our existing follow-up automation.

10. Test the system to confirm that everything operates correctly.



Please identify any technical limitations, additional subscription costs, phone number charges, or usage fees before making changes.



Do not delete existing workflows or make major account changes without approval.



Our goal is to complete the initial setup within the first week, if technically feasible.



Once the system has been tested and approved, the position will transition into the regular part-time schedule.



3. Three Cold-Calling VAs – One CRM Sub-Account



Our company has three cold-calling VAs who need to work independently within the same GoHighLevel sub-account.



Each worker should have:



- Their own CRM login.

- Their own dedicated business phone number.

- Their own assigned leads.

- Their own calling queue.

- Access to the appropriate client information.

- The ability to complete five calling rounds.

- The ability to document calls, voi
s, client responses, and potential cases.



We want each VA's outbound calls to use their assigned phone number.



Incoming calls and client responses should also be routed appropriately whenever possible.



The CRM Manager must evaluate whether the existing GoHighLevel calling system can accomplish these requirements.



4. Automatic Equal Lead Distribution



This is one of our most important requirements.



Our CRM Manager will upload new leads Monday through Friday.



We want the CRM to automatically divide the new leads as equally as possible among our three cold-calling VAs.



For example:



Total Daily Leads| VA 1| VA 2| VA 3

300| 100| 100| 100

600| 200| 200| 200

900| 300| 300| 300

1,200| 400| 400| 400



We believe GoHighLevel's Round Robin assignment feature may accomplish this.



We want the CRM Manager to verify and configure this functionality.



The system should:



- Automatically distribute each new lead batch.

- Keep each VA's leads separated through assigned ownership and calling queues.

- Keep contacts assigned to the same VA throughout the calling rounds.

- Identify and properly handle duplicate contacts.

- Maintain accurate call and follow-up records.

- Avoid unnecessary manual work.



We do not want to manually divide hundreds of leads into three separate spreadsheets every day if the CRM can handle the distribution automatically.



5. Five-Round Cold-Calling and Automation System



Our previous CRM setup included approximately three calling rounds, automated text messages, and weekly follow-up messages.



We want to expand the calling process to five rounds.



Because our daily leads will be divided equally among three workers, each VA will have a smaller list and should be able to spend more time completing additional outreach.



Initial Automated Outreach



At approximately 9:00 a.m. Colorado Mountain Time, we want the CRM to initiate the approved daily outreach campaign for eligible contacts.



This includes:



- One initial automated text message to eligible mobile phone numbers with the necessary consent.

- One initial automated
 to eligible contacts with valid
 addresses, where permitted.



We only want one initial automated
 per new lead campaign.



We do not want repeated automated
s after every calling round.



Five Calling Rounds



Stage| Required Action

Initial Campaign| One approved automated text and one

Round 1| VA calls assigned leads, followed by an approved text

Round 2| VA calls assigned leads, followed by an approved text

Round 3| VA calls assigned leads, followed by an approved text

Round 4| VA calls assigned leads, followed by an approved text

Round 5| VA calls assigned leads, followed by a final approved text



We want the CRM Manager to determine whether text messages can be triggered after each calling round is actually completed.



Calling rounds must be appropriately spaced and comply with applicable outreach requirements. Five rounds do not necessarily mean five calls to the same contact in one day.



If a number is a landline, the VA should call without attempting to send an automated text.



Automated texts must only be sent where the necessary consent and messaging permissions exist.



If a client responds, opts out, signs a contract, or requests no further contact, the CRM should stop inappropriate or unnecessary automated outreach.



Existing Four-Week Follow-Up System



Our previous CRM setup also included approximately four weeks of follow-up outreach.



We want the CRM Manager to evaluate this existing automation and determine whether it should be retained, modified, or replaced.



Our priority is increasing outreach efficiency without creating duplicate or excessive messages.



6. Power Dialer and Calling Queues



We want each VA to log into GoHighLevel and immediately access their assigned calling queue.



Ideally, the system should allow each worker to:



1. Open their assigned lead list.

2. Begin calling using their dedicated business phone number.

3. Progress efficiently through assigned contacts.

4. Record call outcomes and notes.

5. Identify contacts requiring follow-up.

6. Move through Rounds 1–5 in an organized manner.



The CRM Manager should determine whether our existing system supports this through the Power Dialer or another available feature.



Please explain any limitations before configuring the system.



7. Daily Lead Upload Schedule – Monday Through Friday



Our company receives new foreclosure surplus funds leads through our Excess Elite account Monday through Friday.



These leads typically become available around 5:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. Colorado Mountain Time.



However, the exact upload time is not guaranteed.



Sometimes the leads may become available earlier or later.



Because of this, the CRM Manager must have a flexible schedule and be willing to monitor Excess Elite during the Colorado evening or overnight period.



Once the leads become available, you will be responsible for retrieving them and uploading them into GoHighLevel.



Daily Responsibilities



1. Check Excess Elite for newly uploaded leads.

2. Retrieve the latest available lead information.

3. Upload the leads into GoHighLevel.

4. Verify that the information imports correctly.

5. Check for duplicate contacts.

6. Confirm automatic equal distribution among the three VAs.

7. Ensure each worker's calling queue is properly prepared.

8. Verify that approved automated messages are scheduled correctly.

9. Monitor the CRM for errors or technical problems.

10. Ensure the following day's calling campaign is ready.



All new leads must be uploaded, distributed, and ready before 9:00 a.m. Colorado time the following morning.



Weekly Work Schedule



CRM Manager Upload Day| Cold-Calling Day

Monday evening/night| Tuesday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

Tuesday evening/night| Wednesday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

Wednesday evening/night| Thursday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

Thursday evening/night| Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

Friday evening/night| Saturday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.



All scheduling will follow Colorado local time, using the America/Denver time zone, including seasonal daylight saving time changes.



Our cold-calling VAs must be able to begin calling immediately at 9:00 a.m. Tuesday through Saturday without waiting for the CRM Manager to finish uploading or assigning leads.



If Excess Elite experiences an unexpected delay or technical problem, the CRM Manager must notify management promptly.



8. Regular Working Hours



Once the initial CRM setup is completed, the regular position will be:



4 hours per day, 5 days per week, Monday through Friday.



Our previous CRM Manager generally completed daily lead uploads in less than two hours.



We are offering four paid hours per day to allow additional time for:



- Lead uploading.

- CRM monitoring.

- Checking automations.

- Routine troubleshooting.

- Maintaining an organized system.



The position offers flexibility because the exact time leads become available may vary.



The main expectation is that the CRM Manager completes the required work and prepares the CRM before the following morning's calling shift.



9. Compensation – Starting Pay Is Firm



Our starting hourly rate is $1.61 USD. This rate is firm and nonnegotiable.



We have previously had applicants request higher hourly rates.



We understand that different applicants have different salary expectations. However, we are a small, growing company, and our current budget is limited.



We ask applicants to respect the advertised compensation and apply only if they are comfortable accepting this starting rate.



Regular Base Pay



Pay Description| Amount

Hourly rate| $1.61 USD

Daily pay (4 hours)| $6.44 USD

Weekly pay (20 hours)| $32.20 USD

Four-week pay| $128.80 USD



Additional approved working hours during the initial CRM setup will also be paid.



As our company continues to grow and becomes more financially established, we hope to increase hourly compensation in the future.



However, no specific increase or timeline is guaranteed.



We believe our additional bonus structure creates an opportunity for employees to earn substantially more than their hourly base pay when our company has successful recoveries.



10. Additional 5% Net-Profit Bonus



In addition to regular hourly compensation, our CRM Manager will be eligible to earn 5% of the company's net profit from qualifying successful contracts generated by our VA cold-calling team.



Our business sometimes handles substantial surplus funds recovery cases.



Because of this, a single successful contract may produce a meaningful bonus.



Examples of Potential Bonuses



Company Net Profit| Your 5% Bonus

$5,000| $250

$10,000| $500

$20,000| $1,000

$30,000| $1,500

$50,000| $2,500

$100,000| $5,000



These are examples only and do not represent guaranteed earnings.



How Bonuses Are Earned



Our business operates on a pipeline model.



Once a potential client signs a contract, the case may need to go through our attorney network and the appropriate legal recovery process.



Some cases may take approximately two months, six months, one year, or longer before funds are recovered.



The CRM Manager's 5% bonus becomes payable only when:



1. A qualifying contract generated by our cold-calling team results in a successful recovery.

2. The attorney team completes the required recovery process.

3. Asset Recovery Agents of America LLC receives its portion of the recovery.

4. The funds clear the company's bank account.

5. The company's actual net profit is calculated.



The bonus is calculated on the company's actual net profit, not the total amount of surplus funds recovered for the client.



The exact bonus eligibility and payment terms will be established in writing.



Why We Offer Bonuses



We understand that $1.61 per hour is a modest starting rate.



Our company is still growing, and we want to maintain an affordable operating budget while giving our team opportunities to earn additional income.



Our 5% bonus structure is designed to reward employees who contribute to our company's success.



As our company builds its pipeline and successful contracts are paid out throughout the year, our employees have the opportunity to benefit financially.



Our goal is to build a stable, long-term team where everyone has a reason to help the company succeed.



11. Weekly Payday and Payment Method



All employees are paid every Friday, based on Colorado, USA, days and time.



We use Remitly to send payments to our virtual assistants in the Philippines.



Most of our current employees use GCash to receive their payments.



However, you may use another supported receiving method through Remitly.



Payment Details



- Payday: Every Friday, Colorado USA time.

- Payment Frequency: Weekly.

- Payment Service: Remitly.

- Preferred Receiving Method: GCash.

- Alternative Methods: Other available Remitly-supported payment options.

- Regular Weekly Base Pay: $32.20 USD for 20 hours.

- Additional Hours: Approved additional setup hours will be included in the applicable payroll.

- Bonuses: Qualifying bonuses are paid after the company receives its recovery funds, the payment clears the bank account, and the bonus becomes payable.



If you are selected for the position, we will ask you to provide your preferred Remitly receiving information so that we can arrange your Friday payments.



You do not need to provide your payment details when applying.



We will request this information privately after you are selected.



Please understand that Friday is our scheduled payment day in the United States. The exact time funds become available in the Philippines may depend on Remitly and the receiving provider.



12. Required Experience and Qualifications



We are looking for someone who:



- Has previous experience with GoHighLevel CRM.

- Understands workflows and automation systems.

- Can configure multiple users inside one sub-account.

- Understands phone number assignments and calling systems.

- Can configure Round Robin lead distribution.

- Can organize calling queues and follow-up processes.

- Has experience with SMS and
 automations.

- Can troubleshoot technical problems independently.

- Is organized and detail-oriented.

- Can reliably upload daily leads.

- Can work a flexible schedule based on Colorado business operations.

- Communicates clearly and promptly.

- Is comfortable with our fixed starting pay and bonus opportunity.



We prefer someone who can independently identify problems, recommend solutions, and maintain the CRM without constant supervision.



13. Hiring and Testing Process



We will begin by evaluating interested applicants' GoHighLevel experience.



Before offering ongoing employment, we want to confirm that the applicant understands our requirements and can successfully configure the system.



The process will include:



Phase 1 – CRM Evaluation



Review our existing account and explain whether the requested setup is possible.



Phase 2 – Initial Setup



Complete the approved configuration, including the three-VA system, lead distribution, calling queues, and automations.



Additional approved working hours will be paid during this setup period.



Phase 3 – Testing



We will conduct a test using sample leads to confirm that the system distributes contacts correctly, uses the proper phone numbers, and performs the expected calling and messaging functions.



Phase 4 – Cold-Caller Training



Once the CRM is working correctly, I will personally create a training video for our three cold-calling VAs.



Phase 5 – Ongoing Employment



After successful testing and approval, the selected applicant will transition into the regular part-time CRM Manager position.



Our goal is to establish a long-term working relationship with someone who can reliably manage the technical side of our CRM operations.



14. How to Apply



Interested applicants should contact us through WhatsApp.



WhatsApp: +1 (303)
Please send a message introducing yourself and include the following information:



1. Your name and previous experience working with GoHighLevel.

2. Your experience configuring workflows, automations, and lead distribution.

3. Whether you have managed multiple cold-calling users and phone numbers within one sub-account.

4. Whether you can configure a five-round calling system with approved automated text and
 outreach.

5. Whether you are comfortable monitoring daily leads and preparing the CRM before 9:00 a.m. Colorado time.

6. Whether you are willing to work additional approved paid hours during the initial setup period.

7. Confirmation that you accept the starting rate of $1.61 USD per hour, plus the opportunity to earn a 5% net-profit bonus on qualifying contracts.



Please do not apply if you are seeking a higher starting hourly rate.



We respect everyone's experience and salary expectations, but our current compensation is fixed.



We are looking for someone who understands that we are a small company with long-term growth potential and who would like to become part of our team.



Asset Recovery Agents of America LLC



Building a reliable team, growing our business, and sharing in our success.

title: Short Form Video Editor for an Indie Game (Reels, TikTok & YouTube Shorts)
description:
I’m looking for someone to help me create short videos for a turn based roguelite made entirely from text and ASCII art.



The game has ten playable classes, deep character builds, and a sci-fi setting. I want videos that show people why they’d want to play it, even if they’ve never tried an ASCII game before.



**What you’ll do**



- Turn gameplay footage into vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

- Come up with hooks and video ideas around combat, classes, builds, enemies, and interesting gameplay moments.

- Add captions, sound effects, and music where they help.

- Keep the gameplay readable on a phone screen.

- Create different hooks for promising clips so we can test what gets people watching.

- Work with me on feedback and revisions.



I can provide gameplay footage, screenshots, and information about the game. If you’re comfortable playing the game and recording your own clips, mention that in your application.



**Who I’m looking for**



You should have experience editing short form videos, ideally for games. You should know how to catch someone’s attention quickly and keep the video moving without covering everything in effects.



Textmor’s ASCII art is a big part of its identity. You’ll need to preserve the actual artwork and make thoughtful choices about cropping, zooming, and captions.



I’d especially like to work with someone who can suggest ideas and choose interesting moments, instead of needing instructions for every cut. An interest in indie games, roguelikes, or RPGs would help.



**Scope and pay**



This is a part time freelance role to start, with the possibility of ongoing work if we’re a good fit.



Please include your rate per video.



**How to apply**



Please send:



- Two or three examples of short videos you’ve edited, preferably gaming content.

- A brief explanation of what you handled in each example.

- Your rates, availability, and typical turnaround time.



I care more about your work and ideas than a long cover letter. If we seem like a good fit, we’ll start with a small paid trial. Please don't use AI to write your
 to me (AI writing is so generic.)

title: Multimedia Producer
description:
About Tilde Multimedia Firm



Tilde Multimedia Firm is a marketing, advertising, and digital media firm helping businesses strengthen their brands, grow their visibility, and connect with their audiences through strategic content and creative production.



We are seeking a creative, dependable Multimedia Producer based in the Philippines to produce social media graphics, videos, motion graphics, and other digital assets for Tilde Multimedia Firm and our clients.



About the Role



You will turn creative briefs, brand guidelines, raw footage, and marketing ideas into polished, engaging content. This role combines graphic design, video editing, and motion graphics with the ability to manage multiple client brands and meet deadlines.



Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud is required. Adobe applications are our primary production tools. You must be comfortable creating original work, editing existing projects, and delivering organized, editable source files.



Key Responsibilities



Design branded social media graphics, carousels, promotional posts, digital advertisements, and campaign assets.



Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.



Turn raw footage, interviews, photographs, and existing content into compelling visual stories.



Add captions, subtitles, music, sound effects, transitions, lower thirds, and motion graphics.



Create video thumbnails, presentation graphics,
 graphics, digital flyers, and other supporting materials.



Adapt creative assets for different platforms, placements, dimensions, and audiences.



Follow each client’s brand guidelines and maintain consistency across deliverables.



Collaborate with Tilde’s leadership on creative concepts and campaign execution.



Manage assigned projects, communicate progress, and flag missing assets or potential delays early.



Apply feedback and revisions accurately.



Deliver organized, editable Adobe project files with linked assets and final exports.



Review work for spelling, visual quality, audio clarity, brand accuracy, and technical requirements before submission.



Use properly licensed assets and protect confidential client information.



Required Qualifications



A strong portfolio demonstrating graphic design, video editing, and motion graphics.



Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including:



Photoshop: Photo editing, image enhancement, and digital graphics.



Illustrator: Vector graphics, branded design elements, and layouts.



Premiere Pro: Video editing, captions, audio adjustments, and final exports.



After Effects: Animated text, lower thirds, and motion graphics.



Ability to work with existing Adobe projects and prepare complete, editable project handoffs.



Understanding of composition, typography, color, pacing, and visual storytelling.



Experience producing content for social media and digital marketing.



Strong written and spoken English.



Ability to follow creative briefs, manage competing deadlines, and respond constructively to feedback.



Reliable internet access and a computer capable of running Adobe Creative Cloud and handling video production.



Availability for agreed-upon collaboration hours with a U.S.-based team.



Canva and other creative tools may supplement the workflow, but they do not replace the required Adobe Creative Cloud skills.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience supporting a marketing agency or producing creative work for multiple brands.



Experience creating paid social advertisements and promotional videos.



Familiarity with audio cleanup, color correction, and longer-form video editing.



Experience using shared cloud storage and project management tools.



Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools, with careful review for accuracy, quality, and client suitability.



What Success Looks Like



Creative assets are polished, engaging, and aligned with each client’s brand.



Deadlines are met, and updates are communicated consistently.



Feedback is applied accurately with fewer repeated corrections.



Adobe project files and supporting assets are organized and easy for the team to access and reuse.



Creative choices support the campaign’s message, audience, and call to action.



Schedule and Compensation



Workload, collaboration hours, compensation, and engagement terms will be discussed based on experience, availability, and production needs.



How to Apply



Submit your résumé, portfolio link, availability, and expected compensation. Include at least three graphic design samples and three video samples, with at least one example demonstrating motion graphics. Note your contribution and the Adobe applications used for each project.



Briefly describe your proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, and After Effects, along with how you manage multiple projects and deadlines.

title: B2B Sales & Partnerships Specialist
description:

Mintello Cards is a growing U.S.-based personalized card company creating custom trading cards, playing cards, and collectible products for events, businesses, organizations, and individuals.

title: Social Media & Video Content Specialist

 Reels, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

Growth & Performance

Provide weekly updates on social media activity and performance.



Recommend improvements based on analytics and audience behavior.



Proactively suggest new content ideas rather than waiting for assignments.

Previous experience managing social media accounts for businesses.



Strong video editing skills, especially short-form content.



Experience using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, or similar software.



Familiarity with
, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and stay organized.



Creative mindset with an eye for detail.

title: Digital Advertiser / Media Buyer
description:
We are a digital advertising consultancy working with clients across multiple industries on paid media campaigns — primarily Meta and Google Ads. We are looking for a sharp, reliable virtual assistant to work directly under our lead strategist and help execute campaigns, track performance, and keep everything running smoothly.



This is a hands-on execution role. You will be getting campaigns live, pulling reports, and flagging performance issues — not just doing admin work. If you have experience in paid ads and can also handle basic graphic design, this is an ideal fit. We work fast and expect someone who can keep up.



What you'll be doing:



- Setting up and launching ad campaigns on Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads following briefs provided by the lead strategist

- QA-ing campaigns before launch, checking targeting, budgets, placements, pixels, and UTMs

- Monitoring live campaigns daily and flagging anomalies (spend pacing, CTR drops, delivery issues)

- Pulling weekly and monthly performance reports fro
ta, Google Ads, and Google Analytics, summarizing key metrics clearly

- Building simple performance summaries and decks for client reporting

- Creating or resizing ad creatives using Canva, Figma, or Adobe tools, static images, story formats, and basic video thumbnails

- Maintaining organized campaign folders, naming conventions, and documentation

- Supporting additional tasks as needed: research, competitor ad analysis, audience building



Must have:



- Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager (campaign setup, ad sets, audiences)

- Familiarity with Google Ads (Search or Performance Max)

- Able to read and interpret ad performance data (CTR, CPC, ROAS, CPA)

- Experience building performance reports (Google Sheets, Looker Studio, or similar)

- Strong spoken and written English, clear and professional

- Detail-oriented, comfortable working from briefs without hand-holding

- Reliable internet connection and consistent availability



Strong plus:



- Graphic design skills: Canva, Figma, Adobe Photoshop, or Illustrator

- Experience creating ad creatives (static, story, carousel formats)

- Familiarity with Meta Pixel, UTM parameters, and conversion tracking

- Google Analytics 4 experience

- Experience working with a marketing agency or consultant

- Knowledge of audience building: custom audiences, lookalikes, interest stacking

- Basic video editing or caption work (CapCut, Premiere, etc.)



Who this is for:



You have worked in paid media. Either in-house, at an agency, or as a freelancer and understand how digital ad campaigns actually work, not just theoretically. You are comfortable working independently, asking smart questions when needed, and taking ownership of your tasks.



You do not need to be a senior media buyer. You do need to be someone who can execute accurately, communicate clearly, and flag problems proactively instead of waiting to be asked.



How to apply?

Subject line: Start your message with "ADS VA – [your name]" so we know you read this listing

A brief intro (3–5 sentences) describing your paid media experience, specific platforms and what you actually did

At least one example of a campaign or report you worked on (describe it, no confidential info needed)

If you have design experience, share 2–3 samples of ad creative you have made

Your availability (hours/week) and preferred working hours in your time zone

Your rate expectation in USD per hour or per month

Please fill out this form to be considered.

title: B2B Client Acquisition Specialist
description:
About the Opportunity



We're a U.S.-based professional services company supporting small businesses, particularly those in trucking, transportation, and logistics.



We're looking for a dependable, personable, and organized B2B Client Acquisition Specialist to help us build and maintain relationships with prospective clients.



This is a hands-on sales role for someone who enjoys talking to business owners, understands how to identify business needs, and can confidently guide a prospect from the initial conversation through enrollment.



We're a growing company with a small team and straightforward systems. We value initiative, good judgment, attention to detail, and consistent communication.



We're not looking for someone who needs to be micromanaged. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work.



What You'll Do



Prospecting & Outreach



Make outbound calls to U.S. business owners using prospect lists we provide.



Answer and return inbound business calls through our cloud-based phone system.



Introduce our services professionally and identify potential opportunities.



Qualify prospects based on their business needs and fit with our services.



Sales & Client Acquisition



Conduct discovery conversations with interested prospects.



Explain our approved services, packages, and pricing.



Address common questions and objections professionally.



Follow up with prospective clients and help convert qualified opportunities into paying customers.



Know when to escalate questions or requests outside your authority.



Pipeline Management



Maintain accurate lead records and follow-up schedules.



Track calls, conversations, appointments, proposals, and enrollment status.



Follow through on outstanding opportunities without requiring constant reminders.



Provide concise activity updates and pipeline reports.



Client Enrollment



Coordinate approved proposals and engagement letters.



Follow up on outstanding agreements and initial payments.



Collect basic onboarding information.



Ensure new clients are properly handed off to our service delivery team.



What We're Looking For



At least 1 year of experience in outbound B2B sales, cold calling, appointment setting, or client acquisition.



Excellent spoken and written English.



A confident, friendly, and professional telephone presence.



Experience communicating with U.S.-based customers or business owners.



Strong follow-up habits and attention to detail.



Ability to work independently and manage assigned responsibilities.



Comfortable using Microsoft 365, including Outlook and Excel.



Reliable internet connection, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace.



Availability during assigned U.S. Central Time business hours.



Preferred, but not required:



Experience selling professional or subscription-based services.



Familiarity with trucking, logistics, transportation, or small-business operations.



Experience using Quo (formerly OpenPhone) or another cloud phone system.



Experience maintaining sales pipelines or customer records.



Ability to identify opportunities to improve existing processes.



What We Provide



We provide targeted prospect lists, access to our business phone system, approved service packages and pricing, sales guidance, and the tools needed to perform the role.



Our systems are straightforward, and we primarily use Microsoft 365.



We offer a consistent monthly base, additional incentives for successfully acquired clients, and the opportunity to grow with the company.



Compensation



$750 USD monthly base for approximately 25 hours per week, plus a performance incentive for each qualifying new client successfully enrolled.



Specific incentive terms will be discussed during the selection process.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction describing your professional background and relevant experience.



A summary of your outbound B2B calling experience, particularly with U.S. businesses.



One specific example of a qualified lead, appointment, or paying customer you helped acquire.



The tools you've used to manage calls, leads, and follow-ups.



Confirmation that you understand the $750 monthly base for approximately 25 hours per week, plus performance incentives.



Confirmation of your availability during U.S. Central Time business hours.



A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and demonstrating how you would open a cold call to a U.S. small-business owner.



Important: Use B2B CAS as the subject line of your application message. This helps us confirm that you've reviewed the full posting.



Applications missing the requested information may not be considered.

title: Experienced US Healthcare Recruiter/Talent Sourcer
description:

Salary: $800 – $1,200 USD/month base (dependent on experience) + performance-based placement bonuses

Target Industry: US Healthcare Staffing & Travel Nursing 

About Us:

ASA Healthcare Staffing is a rapidly growing, US-based healthcare staffing agency. We hold strategic commercial partnerships with nationwide networks and execute high-profile federal government healthcare staffing contracts. We are looking for an aggressive, metrics-driven Healthcare Recruiter based in the Philippines to join our team and act as the primary engine for candidate sourcing, pre-screening, and initial pipeline generation.

Candidate Sourcing: Proactively identify, source, and engage qualified healthcare professionals (Registered Nurses, Allied Health, NPs, PAs) using LinkedIn, Indeed, niche job boards, and specialized social media networks.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for US Marketing Agency
description:
Summary



We’re hiring 2 appointment setters to call home service business owners in Florida, including plumbing, HVAC, and painting contractors. You’ll speak with the owner directly. Your job is to book a short intro call, not to sell.



What you’ll do



- Cold call business owners from lists we provide, using a power dialer. At times you may need to find leads yourself, and we’ll help with that.

- Call inbound leads and follow up with people who no-showed an earlier appointment.

- Qualify the owner and book the call.

- Build up to 180 dials a day over your first three weeks.



Hours



This is a night shift. Our best calling windows are 11:00am to 1:30pm and 4:00pm to 5:30pm US Eastern, which is overnight in the Philippines. Please only apply if that works for you long term.



Pay



- Base plus commission for every booked appointment that shows up.

- Around $1,400 a month at target performance. Strong setters earn more.

- Full details on the interview call.



What we offer



- Daily training and a daily huddle until you’re ramped up

- One of your calls reviewed with you every day for your first two weeks



Who we want



- A hunter

- Someone who naturally follows up, consistently, without being reminded

- Clear, neutral English. This is a must.

- Prior cold calling or appointment setting experience is a plus, not a requirement

- Full-time availability



About us



We’re a marketing agency for home service contractors. We build websites, optimize Google Business Profiles, and automate review requests so contractors get more jobs from Google. You won’t be selling any of this. You just need to be able to explain it in a sentence when an owner asks who’s calling.



To apply: please include an audio recording of your voice with your application. Any recording works, including one you already have. We won’t review your application without an audio recording. This role is on live calls with US owners, so I want to hear how you sound.

title: Senior Paid Media Analyst (Google Ads & Meta Ads)
description:
About the Role



We’re looking for a full-time Senior Paid Media Analyst to independently own the strategy, execution, and performance of Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns across assigned client accounts.



This is not a “follow the platform recommendations” role. We need an analytical, proactive problem-solver who knows how to scale e-commerce campaigns profitably, spots growth opportunities without being asked, and takes real ownership of client results.



What You’ll Do



CAMPAIGN AND STRATEGY MANAGEMENT

Build, launch, manage, and optimize Google Ads and Meta campaigns from scratch

Develop paid media strategies tied to client goals: e-commerce revenue, profitability, and lead generation

Manage budgets, pacing, bidding, targeting, and spend allocation

Run keyword research, search term analysis, and audience development

Manage Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Meta prospecting, remarketing, and catalog campaigns

Test campaign structures, bidding, audiences, creative, and new platform features

Troubleshoot performance drops, conversion tracking discrepancies, and delivery issues

Collaborate with internal teams on creative direction, promotions, and client initiatives



E-COMMERCE GROWTH

Build strategies that grow online sales, revenue, and profitable customer acquisition

Analyze ROAS, revenue, conversion rate, AOV, and CAC

Scale winning campaigns through budget allocation, audience expansion, product segmentation, and creative testing

Evaluate product-level performance across Shopping, Performance Max, and Meta catalog campaigns

Make recommendations based on revenue and profitability, not traffic or engagement



REPORTING AND CLIENT COMMUNICATIONS

Monitor CPA, ROAS, CPC, CTR, CVR, conversions, revenue, and AOV

Diagnose trends and turn data into clear, actionable recommendations

Maintain accurate campaign reporting

Join monthly or quarterly client calls and confidently present results, challenges, and strategy



REQUIREMENTS

3+ years of hands-on paid media experience, including building and launching campaigns from scratch

Experience managing individual client accounts with at least $10,000 in monthly ad spend per account (not combined spend across clients)

Proven e-commerce advertising experience with a track record of scaling revenue and ROAS

Strong proficiency in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager

Hands-on experience with Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Meta conversion campaigns

Solid grasp of campaign structure, bidding strategies, audience targeting, keyword management, and budget optimization

Working knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and attribution

Familiarity with Google Merchant Center and product feeds

Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills

Ability to manage multiple accounts, budgets, and deadlines at once

Clear, confident communication with clients and internal teams



Nice to Have

- Agency experience managing clients across different industries

- Experience with both e-commerce and lead generation campaigns

- Experience with Microsoft Advertising, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Basis, GroundTruth, or other programmatic platforms

- Familiarity with TapClicks, Shopify, Meta Commerce Manager, product catalogs, and Klaviyo

- Experience building creative testing strategies and giving performance-based creative recommendations



Send the following:

1. Your resume - make sure it's a shareable link

2. Portfolio which includes the largest single account you’ve managed: industry, monthly ad spend, and one result you’re proud of (e.g., ROAS or revenue growth)

3. The platforms you’ve built campaigns on from scratch



Applications missing these details will not be considered and only qualified applicants will be contacted. 

Thank you and good luck!
